operator.coordinates: Both sources: x toward offense goal from snap-ball/declared LOS, y rotated with attack and centered on snap ball; positions rounded0.1yd.
operator.retreat: Largest negative individual OL movement from snap, clipped at0; distinct from depth behind LOS.
operator.aggregation: One five-OL observation per play at each slice; group percentiles are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
operator.censoring: Exact snapshot with all five OL and slice strictly before ending/recording boundary; no interpolation/forward filling.
operator.underCenter: Snap QB-C longitudinal gap0–2.5yd and lateral gap<=1yd; alignment proxy, not verified coaching classification.
operator.12: Exactly11 offensive players including five identified OL, oneQB, oneRB, twoWR, twoTE, noFB; roster-position proxy.
operator.twoAttached: Both TE snap depth[-1.2,.7]yd, one just outside each OL end within2yd; geometry proxy.
